name: ibis Gading Serpong
short_description: A 3-star, Green Key-certified budget hotel inside Summarecon Serpong, about a 10-minute walk from Summarecon Mall Serpong.
ai_summary: ibis Gading Serpong is a 3-star, Green Key-certified economy hotel at Jalan Boulevard Gading Serpong, Blok M5 No. 19 in Summarecon Serpong, Tangerang, about a 10-minute walk (roughly 700 meters) from Summarecon Mall Serpong. Rooms are compact standard doubles or twins, and the property offers an on-site restaurant and bar, meeting space for up to 600 guests, a spa, and a shuttle service to nearby malls, positioned near ICE BSD and Soekarno-Hatta International Airport with several universities nearby. Accor's own listing confirms it participates in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, with members earning and redeeming Status & Rewards points and access to member rates. Guest reviews are strongly positive on cleanliness and value, with an ALL rating of 4.9/5 from 260 reviews, though independent 2024-2025 video and TripAdvisor coverage is mixed, ranging from strongly recommended stays to at least one guest describing an experience below expectations.

faqs.question: Does ibis Gading Serpong participate in the ALL loyalty programme?
faqs.answer: Yes -- unlike some budget-tier ibis properties in Indonesia, this hotel's own Accor listing confirms full ALL - Accor Live Limitless participation, with members earning and redeeming Status & Rewards points, accessing member rates, and qualifying for the ALL Accor+ ibis subscription's 15% year-round discount across ibis brands.

faqs.question: How far is ibis Gading Serpong from Summarecon Mall Serpong?
faqs.answer: The hotel sits inside Summarecon Serpong itself, about a 10-minute walk or roughly 700 meters from Summarecon Mall Serpong, making shopping and dining easily accessible on foot. It also offers a shuttle service to nearby malls and is positioned close to ICE BSD and Soekarno-Hatta International Airport.
